_about: Single source of truth for plan facts on every public page (read by ops/seo/plans.py). Change a fact here, then run python ops/seo/prepublish.py, which regenerates the marked regions of index.html and plans.html and fails on any page that disagrees. Sources: plan_limit_for() (migration 030; any paid plan other than kickstart/pro/elite gets 1, which is Solo), PAID_PLANS / ELITE_PLANS and FREE_TRIAL_DAYS=7 in the backend, migration 042, Whop plans, outreach/00-fact-sheet.md. Check speed comes from check-interval.json, not from here.

free_trial.during: 24/7 with push alerts, like a paid plan
free_trial.after: checked only while the dashboard is open
